notes.title: v1.03: New UI & Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you for playing Plastris! I'm surprised to see that it's one of my most popular Steam releases (out of the 9 games I uploaded here so far), and I'd like to repay you for your support.

I returned to Plastris to release a small, but handy update. It addresses one of the game's biggest issues (players not knowing what to do when they first launch the game) and fixes a few minor bugs.

New stuff:
- Added 2 new UI elements which show what "plus" and "minus" shapes are available to you on the current level.

Changes:
- Upon returning to menu, you'll now see the level selection page that contains your last played level (useful for clearing skipped levels).

Fixed bugs:
- Cursor is now always properly changing when hovering over UI elements.
- Environment (crystal cave/desert/winter) no longer "forgets" to change to a different one after a few levels.
- Each environment now has the intended saturation & contrast settings.

I hope you'll enjoy these changes. Happy holidays! :)

Yours sincerely,
Ivan (Khud0)

Sincerely yours,

notes.title: v1.02 - Better Controls, Minor QoL Changes
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

In this update I synchronized the keybinds from Shatris with the ones in Plastris. You can find the new shortcuts in this Steam Discussions topic. One of the main changes is that you can now switch between "+" and "-" shapes using a mouse wheel. (Wow, how come did I not think about that when developing Plastris?).

Also, I changed the size of the in-game camera a bit, so by default objects will look smaller right now. The reason why they were so big in the first place is because it's quite hard to tell if something is huge or not when you're seeing the game in a tiny editor window instead of a full-screen view. My bad, sorry. ^^

I hope that you will enjoy the changes and we will meet again soon!

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.01 - Multiple Platforms, Minor QoL Changes
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

In this tiny update I implemented a few "quality of life" features, suggested by our wonderful community:

- Pause button (Also "Escape" and "P" shortcuts) will now take you to the level selection screen instead of the main menu. (Suggested by Dohi64).

- Left / Right arrows on your keyboard can now be used to load previous and next level accordingly. (Suggested by Dohi64).

- Sound / music settings will be applied immediately upon changing their values. (Suggested by multiple people).

- Sound effects should no longer interrupt each other in certain occasions.

- In addition to Windows, Plastris should now work on Mac OS X and Linux. I say "should", because I have nothing to test these versions on, so if something goes wrong don't hesitate to let me know in this forum topic.

If you'd like to contribute to the game by sharing your suggestions with me, please leave them on the "Discussions" forum. :)

I hope that you will enjoy the changes and we will meet again soon. ːgrizzland_heartː

Yours forever,
Khud0
